description: Use this module for power management.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Encryption key to connect to the BMC in hex format.

parameters.name: machine
parameters.description: Provide a list of the remote target address for the bridge IPMI request, and the power status. Either this option or state is required.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether to ensure that the machine specified by machine[].targetAddress in desired state. If this option is not set, the power state is set by state. If both this option and state are set, this option takes precedence over state. Choices: "on" "off" "shutdown" "reset" "boot"

parameters.name: targetAddress
parameters.description: Remote target address for the bridge IPMI request.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Hostname or IP address of the BMC.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password to connect to the BMC.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Maximum number of seconds before interrupt request. Default: 300

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Username to use to connect to the BMC.

examples:
- name: Ensure machine is powered on
  community.general.ipmi_power:
    name: test.testdomain.com
    user: admin
    password: password
    state: 'on'

- name: Ensure machines of which remote target address is 48 and 50 are powered off
  community.general.ipmi_power:
    name: test.testdomain.com
    user: admin
    password: password
    state: 'off'
    machine:
      - targetAddress: 48
      - targetAddress: 50

- name: Ensure machine of which remote target address is 48 is powered on, and 50 is powered off
  community.general.ipmi_power:
    name: test.testdomain.com
    user: admin
    password: password
    machine:
      - targetAddress: 48
        state: 'on'
      - targetAddress: 50
        state: 'off'

return_values.name: powerstate
return_values.description: The current power state of the machine. Returned: success and machine is not provided Sample: "on"

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: The current power state of the machine when the machine option is set. Returned: success and machine is provided Sample: [{"powerstate": "on", "targetAddress": 48}, {"powerstate": "on", "targetAddress": 50}]

return_values.name: targetAddress
return_values.description: The remote target address. Returned: success
